premises.text: Studio-controlled video production and wild uncurated user-generated content are divided worlds that need bridging for high-impact video at scale
premises.evidence_span: The video landscape is divided on one side we have a tightly controlled industry driven by studios and agencies and on the other side there's this explosion of user generated content online that's kind of crazy and wild and uncurated

premises.text: Tools let clients engage their own fans, customers, and employees as filmers via instructed community capture projects rather than building a scenic community
premises.evidence_span: enabling companies to produce high-impact video at scale by engaging their own communities of fans, customers, and employees to become the filmers

premises.text: Studio workflow covers project setup, filming instructions, rights-cleared uploads, auto tagging/analysis, and multiple edit paths including freelance editors
premises.evidence_span: All of the video is then automatically tagged, analyzed, and processed on upload as well

premises.text: Subscription commercial model for organizations producing community-sourced video across media, retail, and enterprise
premises.evidence_span: now we're fully into a subscription model

premises.text: ML content-search tools (sentiment, object recognition, transcription) automate finding and using collected footage
premises.evidence_span: we're coming out of beta in our content search tools so you can now search sentiment analysis object recognition and transcription

value.text: High-impact video at scale by leveraging clients' own passionate communities as filmers
value.evidence_span: create the biggest impact by leveraging the communities that they already train who are the most passionate about their brand today
